Slide 1 — Welcome & Onboarding Overview
- Brief company and team introductions
- Objectives for today’s onboarding session
- What success looks like after onboarding

Slide 2 — Agenda & Timeline
- Key milestones and estimated dates
- Roles & responsibilities (customer vs. our team)
- Major deliverables and checkpoints

Slide 3 — Product & Value Proposition
- Core features and primary customer benefits
- Typical use cases and quick-win scenarios
- How this fits into your existing workflows

Slide 4 — Implementation & Setup
- Step-by-step setup and configuration tasks
- Data migration, integrations, and dependencies
- Security, access controls, and compliance notes

Slide 5 — Training & Resources
- Hands-on training sessions and schedule
- Documentation, tutorials, and self-serve assets
- Assigned onboarding contacts and contact process

Slide 6 — Next Steps & Ongoing Success
- Immediate action items and short-term goals
- Support model, escalation path, and SLAs
- Success metrics, review cadence, and renewal planning
